title: Lobo's recipes and more
body:
I have made this Datapack with a lot of recipes.
Campfire can cock ores, rottenflesh and wheat. Blast furnaces can cock raw blocks. Fournaces can cock leather armors, rottenflesh and wheat. Smoker can make bread with wheat.
Chainmail armor can be crafted with chains.
Mob spawner and eggs have recipes.
Horse armore, bell, bone, charcoal block, elytra, mycelium, name tag, nether wart block, notch apple, quartz block to quartz, sticky piston with honeycomb, totem and trident can be crafted.
Wool can become strings and pls try wood in the stonecutter :-D
